differences: The native medium route inspector is intentionally hidden until invoked rather than persistently consuming workspace width.
The native compact inspector overlays the detail task as a 340 px side sheet instead of shrinking every pane.
The GPUI navigation rail uses readable Chinese initials instead of a bundled icon asset set.
suggestions: Preserve the copper signal line as the only strong non-semantic accent.
Keep compact list and detail as separate tasks rather than forcing multi-pane compression.
Replace navigation initials only when a deliberate cross-platform icon asset pipeline is introduced.
next_actions: Ship the verified native GPUI visual milestone as a Git commit.
Keep Mihomo integration outside this visual milestone so demo and observed connection states cannot be confused.
reasoning: The native GPUI implementation preserves the selected Signal Patch Bay direction across wide, medium, and compact window classes. Direct texture captures confirm legible light and dark themes, single-task compact navigation, and a distinctive connected route chain; simulated clicks also prove policy selection, theme switching, and inspector opening in the compact flow.
